content:
deploy-bot: staging deploy started: service=hydra, env=staging, commit=3f8a9b2, tag=release/v2.4.1, initiator=@maria. Rolling canary -> 10%

maria: kicking off smoke + db migration planned at +5m. watchlist: latency, error-rate, reranker

sam: running smoke now -> `curl -sS https://staging.api.internal/hydra/health` -> OK

sre-oncall: watching infra metrics, enabling trace sampling. alert thresholds set: p95>250ms or error-rate>1% :mag_right:

jax: fyi this build includes reranker_v2 weight change. if quality regresses we should be able to pin to previous variant. @deploy-bot can you accept pin requests?

deploy-bot: pin requests supported. can pin to commit=2c7d4e1 within 3m. progressing canary: 10% -> 30% in 5m unless held

sam: quick smoke samples (chat endpoint): `{"status":"ok","latency_ms":120}` - looks nominal from this run

maria: seeing small p95 uptick on token gen (+~30ms) for chat. watching for sustained change

sre-oncall: error spike from 0.6% -> 1.3% at t+8m, digging through logs, tagging @eng-runtime

eng-runtime-lead: on it. logs show reranker_v2 returning fewer candidates for some queries. enabling fallback to reranker_v1 for 5% traffic while we investigate

maria: hold traffic shift at 30% for now. please apply pin to previous model variant so we stabilize. @deploy-bot pin=2c7d4e1
deploy-bot: pin applied: model_variant=reranker_v1, commit pinned=2c7d4e1. Canary traffic held at 30%. Notifying #eng-releases and related watchers :information_source:

maria: thanks. can we run a quick A/B on captured queries to verify quality delta? @sam can you grab ~50 queries and run eval?

sam: running capture -> `python tools/capture_queries.py --count 50 --route=chat` -> capture complete, uploading artifacts to S3 -> s3://redwood-ci/staging/hydra/captures/1976543210/

deploy-bot: staging deploy completed (held state): service=hydra, final_commit=2c7d4e1 (pinned), duration=12m. No rollback performed. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: will monitor for 30m. if error-rate >1.5% we'll escalate and consider rollback. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
